Jiang" initials="S." surname="Jiang"/> <date month="May" year="2016"/> <abstract> <t>DHCPv6 is a protocol that is used to provide addressing and configuration information to IPv6 hosts. This document describes the privacy issues associated with the use of DHCPv6 by Internet users. It is intended to be an analysis of the present situation and does not propose any solutions.</t> </abstract> </front> <seriesInfo name="RFC" value="7824"/> <seriesInfo name="DOI" value="10.17487/RFC7824"/> </reference>
